items.body: The indexed-target guard uses SQLite `COLLATE NOCASE`, which only folds ASCII, while filesystem matching uses Unicode lowercase and NFC normalization. With an indexed `Überblick.md`, `[x](überblick)` now becomes `links.outside-index` despite its target being indexed. I reproduced this using the changed helper and an in-memory database.
items.suggestion: Compare indexed paths using the same `pathKey` normalization as filesystem paths. Add a regression covering non-ASCII case differences and preserve the indexed target’s existing classification.
